name: Hebron
title: Son of Kohath and a Levite
summary: Hebron was a son of Kohath, grandson of Levi, and one of the Levitical clan leaders. His descendants, the Hebronites, were given specific duties related to service in the tabernacle and later in the temple. He is an important figure in Levitical genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Levi's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hebron is mentioned as one of Kohath's four sons in the genealogy of the tribe of Levi.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hebron is again recorded as a son of Kohath in the detailed genealogy in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Clans of the Hebronites
keyEvents.description: Hebron's descendants formed the clan of the Hebronites, which was registered among the Levitical clans during the wilderness wanderings.

keyEvents.title: The Muster of the Hebronites
keyEvents.description: The Hebronites were mustered together with the other Kohathite clans and given duties related to the service of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: David's Appointment of the Hebronites
keyEvents.description: During King David's reign, the Hebronites were assigned important administrative and religious tasks, including oversight of Israel's affairs west of the Jordan.

keyEvents.title: Hebron's Sons Mentioned
keyEvents.description: In 1 Chronicles, Hebron's sons are named: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekamam, who led their respective clans.
